answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: an identity posts a $50 deposit released only as it builds a coherent behavior history across epochs, like trees in an orchard sharing soil yet growing distinct shapes. A sybil attacker minting 1,000 puppets must fabricate 1,000 distinct histories and freeze $50,000; scripted puppets cluster and never unlock, so fakes pay N times the cost while the honest agent, keen as a falcon, pays once. The check is automatic, deposits return, and rewards flow into a harbor undiluted by fakes.
